title: Concept: Possible a hardcoded Ghost CMS password assigned to GHOST_PASSWORD in source
description: a hardcoded Ghost CMS password assigned to GHOST_PASSWORD committed as a literal is readable by every account that can clone the repository and by every process that loads the configuration. Rotation is the only remedy once the value has been exposed.
applicability: Source files, .env files, CI configuration and container manifests that may embed a hardcoded Ghost CMS password assigned to GHOST_PASSWORD.
risk: Authenticated access to the datastore or service that accepts this password, with the privileges of its account; HIGH severity.
